name: Glarity
summary: Adds AI summaries next to Google results and on YouTube videos, web pages and PDFs, with translation and questions about the page you are on. Its code is open source.
audience: People who research online and want quick summaries of videos, search results and long pages, including in other languages.
pros: Works on YouTube, Google search results, ordinary web pages and local PDFs
Source code is public on GitHub
The developer says it shows no ads and does not sell user data
cons: Summaries come from a ChatGPT service, while the developer's privacy text says data stays in the browser: read the privacy details before using it on sensitive pages
Covers many tasks (YouTube, search, PDF, email help), so it is broader than a single-purpose tool
pricing_note: The store listing describes it as free; no paid plan is mentioned there.
alternatives: Webpilot - Copilot for All, Free & Open

name: Writely
summary: A writing helper that brings AI drafting, translation and reading support to editor pages across the web, in the spirit of Notion AI. It is marked as a beta.
audience: Writers and professionals who draft emails, posts and articles in the browser and have an OpenAI API key.
pros: Works on editor pages across the web, not one app
Covers drafting, translation and reading help in one extension
Source code is public on GitHub
cons: Needs your own OpenAI API key and a settings step before it works, according to the README
The store listing was last updated in February 2025, so check that it is still maintained
pricing_note: The store page states no price; the README says you need your own OpenAI API key, which has its own cost.
alternatives: Webpilot - Copilot for All, Free & Open

name: YouTube Summary with ChatGPT & Claude
summary: Summarises YouTube videos, web articles and PDFs and offers the video transcript when one exists, using several AI models including ChatGPT, Claude, Mistral and Gemini.
audience: Learners and researchers who want the key points of long videos and articles quickly.
pros: Covers YouTube videos, web articles and PDFs
Summaries can include timestamps that jump to that part of the video
Offers the transcript when one is available
cons: The listing says it offers in-app purchases, so some features may be paid
The listing's privacy section says it handles personally identifiable information and website content
pricing_note: Described as a free extension; the listing also says it offers in-app purchases.
alternatives: YoutubeDigest: summarize and translate using ChatGPT

name: Mouse Tooltip Translator
summary: Translates text when you hover over it, including text in PDFs and images (OCR), and shows dual subtitles on YouTube and Netflix. Translation is done by Google Translate and Bing.
audience: Language learners and readers of foreign-language sites, PDFs and subtitles.
pros: Hover translation without leaving the page
Handles PDFs, text inside images (OCR) and read-aloud
Dual subtitles for YouTube and Netflix
cons: Translation comes from Google Translate and Bing, not from an AI chat model
The listing's privacy section lists user activity among the data it handles
pricing_note: The store page states no price; the source code is public on GitHub.
alternatives: Manga Translator - Comics Translator | Manga Tracker
